entities.name: Anthimus of Nicomedia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anthimus of Nicomedia, was the bishop of Nicomedia in Bithynia, where he was beheaded during a persecution of Christians, traditionally placed under Diocletian, in which "rivers of blood" flowed.
